scope.primary_question: Quantify within- and among-taxon spatial associations between auditable image-defined capitulum phenotype modules and a phenotype-blind, pre-frozen abiotic exposure representation in the native range.
scope.biotic_scope: Pollinator filtering and other biotic mechanisms are outside the current estimand because no directly comparable global exposure layer is available. They may be discussed only as untested alternative mechanisms and are not a completion gate for Chapter 1 v3.
scope.causal_ceiling: Spatial association does not establish plasticity, selection, adaptation, mechanism, independent origin or convergence.

design_hold.reason: Biological hypotheses are now specified, but the native-range phenotype-blind environment candidate matrix must be diagnosed and the final minimal representation frozen before any v3 trait join or ecological coefficient is inspected.
next_required_artifacts: environment-only diagnostics from the full-source native-range taxon-balanced cohort
